cases.name: task_run_action
cases.reason: Task.Run(Action) currently invokes the delegate inline instead of queueing it to the default executor.

cases.name: closure_shared_capture
cases.reason: A read-only closure capture currently snapshots a value instead of sharing the captured variable.

cases.name: runtime_exceptions
cases.reason: Runtime guards currently log and substitute values instead of throwing the corresponding catchable C# exceptions.

cases.name: async_hot_start
cases.reason: Async calls currently return a cold coroutine frame instead of running synchronously to the first incomplete await.

cases.name: task_result_repeat
cases.reason: Task<T> does not yet use a stable result-bearing control block and Task.Run(Func<T>) is missing.
